```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(emmeans)
library(multcompView)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(NatParksPalettes)
library(readxl)
library(tidytext)
library(readr)
un_anova_tukey <- function(df, feature_col, metrics) {
  feature_col <- rlang::ensym(feature_col)

  # Convert feature column to factor
  df <- df %>% mutate(!!feature_col := as.factor(!!feature_col))

  # Loop over each metric
  results <- map_df(metrics, function(metric) {
    # Construct formula like: accuracy_score ~ feature_set
    formula <- as.formula(paste0(metric, " ~ ", rlang::as_label(feature_col)))

    # Run ANOVA
    aov_model <- aov(formula, data = df)
    anova_p <- summary(aov_model)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]

    # Run Tukey HSD posthoc
    tukey <- TukeyHSD(aov_model)
    tukey_df <- as.data.frame(tukey[[1]])
    tukey_df$comparison <- rownames(tukey_df)

    # Add columns to identify metric
    tukey_df <- tukey_df %>%
      mutate(
        metric = metric,
        anova_p = anova_p
      ) %>%
      select(metric, anova_p, comparison, everything())
    
    return(tukey_df)
  })

  return(results)
}

```

```{r}
ml_df <- read.csv("~/Documents/GitHub/PreclinicalAD_GutMicrobiome-Inflammation/R/Data/ML/combined_restarted_kernel_notau.csv") 

tukey_CG <- ml_df %>%  filter(str_detect(feature_set, "clinical_")) %>% un_anova_tukey(.,  feature_col = feature_set,
  metrics = c("accuracy_score", "sensitivity", "specificity")) 
write.csv(tukey_CG, "~/Documents/GitHub/AD_longitudinal/outputs/260331/260331_ML_CS_preds_CG_models_tukey_results.csv", row.names = F)

tukey_AD <- ml_df %>% filter(str_detect(feature_set, "AD_")) %>% un_anova_tukey(.,  feature_col = feature_set,
  metrics = c("accuracy_score", "sensitivity", "specificity")) 
write.csv(tukey_AD, "~/Documents/GitHub/AD_longitudinal/outputs/260331/260331_ML_CS_preds_AD_models_tukey_results.csv", row.names = F)

### 1. Create AD model panel
df_AD <- ml_df %>% 
  filter(str_detect(feature_set, "AD_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(sensitivity, specificity, accuracy_score),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Model = case_when(
      feature_set == "AD_base" ~ "AD",
      feature_set == "AD_guild" ~ "AD + I + Guild",
      feature_set == "AD_guild_split" ~ "AD + I + Guild Split",
      feature_set == "clinical_base" ~ "CG",
      feature_set == "clinical_guild" ~ "CG + I +Guild",
      feature_set == "clinical_guild_split" ~ "CG + I +Guild Split"
    )
  )
write.csv(df_AD, "~/Documents/GitHub/AD_longitudinal/outputs/260331/260331_cross-sectional_AD_ML_models_performance_metrics.csv", row.names = F)
  
### 2. Now compute y.max AFTER df_long exists
y_max_AD <- df_AD %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(y.max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

### 3. Add significance annotation info
y_pos_multiplier = 1.0
y_spacing = 0.01

sign_AD_fig <- tukey_AD %>%
  separate(comparison, into = c("model1", "model2"), sep = "-") %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = case_match(model1,
      "AD_base" ~ "AD",
      "AD_guild" ~ "AD + I + Guild",
      "AD_guild_split" ~ "AD + I + Guild Split",
      "clinical_base" ~ "CG",
      "clinical_guild" ~ "CG + I +Guild",
      "clinical_guild_split" ~ "CG + I +Guild Split"
    ),
    group2 = case_match(model2,
      "AD_base" ~ "AD",
      "AD_guild" ~ "AD + I + Guild",
      "AD_guild_split" ~ "AD + I + Guild Split",
      "clinical_base" ~ "CG",
      "clinical_guild" ~ "CG + I +Guild",
      "clinical_guild_split" ~ "CG + I +Guild Split"
    ),
    Model = group1
  ) %>%
  left_join(y_max_AD, by = "metric") %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = y.max * (y_pos_multiplier + y_spacing * row_number()),
    p_adj_sign = case_when(
      `p adj` <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      `p adj` <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      `p adj` <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

## Rename "p adj" to "p.adj"
sign_AD_fig <- sign_AD_fig %>% dplyr::rename(p.adj = "p adj")

### 4. Plot
p_AD <- ggplot(df_AD, aes(x = Model, y = value, fill = Model)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  #geom_jitter(width = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=natparks.pals("CapitolReef")) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, ncol=1) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))) +  ## Add 25% extra space above the max value in each facet
  labs(x = "",
    y = "Metric Value",
    title = ""
  ) +  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)) 

sign_AD_fig_sig <- sign_AD_fig %>% filter(p.adj <= 0.05)
p_AD_sign <- p_AD
if (nrow(sign_AD_fig_sig) > 0) {
  p_AD_sign <- p_AD_sign +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      sign_AD_fig_sig,
      label = "p_adj_sign",
      y.position = "y.position",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      bracket.size = 0.6,
      tip.length = 0.01, size = 4,
      step.increase = 0,
      facet.y = "metric"
    )
}
ggsave(filename="~/Documents/GitHub/AD_longitudinal/outputs/260331/260331_ML_CS_preds_AD_models_pvalue.pdf", plot = p_AD_sign, width = 3, height = 8)
```

Plot inclusion matrix
```{r, eval=FALSE}
########################### Plot model feature details ################################
covariates <- c("Age", "Sex", "Education (years)", "BMI", "Hypertension", "Diabetes", "APOE e4", "WMH volume", "Hippocampus volume",
                "Cortical signature", "PET tau", "CSF t-tau", "CSF p-tau-181","PET Amyloid","Calprotectin","Guild abundance", "Guild taxa abundance")
models <- c(unique(df_cg_long$Model), unique(df_AD_long$Model))

matrix <- read_excel("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/DantasLab/AD_microbiome/Paper2/Final_Figures/No_symptomatics/Figure 4/251113_ML_model_var_inclusion_matrix.xlsx")

# Define x- and y-axis model order
y_order <- covariates
x_order <- c(unique(df_cg_long$Model), unique(df_AD_long$Model))

# Define covariate variable colors
cov_colors <- c(
  rep("black", 6),         # demographic and clinical covariates
  rep("#6B7F7F", 1),        # Genetic risk factors
  rep("#CF932C", 3),        # Neurodegeneration and injury
  rep("#7F4B89", 1),        # AD tau proteinopathy
  rep("#B46DB3", 2),        # Phosphorylated and secreted AD tau
  rep("#304F7D", 1),        # Amyloid 
  rep("#CB7223", 1),
  rep("#289A84", 2)       # Selected taxa
)
names(cov_colors) <- y_order

# Turn labels into HTML with color
y_labels_colored <- paste0(
  "<span style='color:", cov_colors, ";'><b>", y_order, "</b></span>"
)
names(y_labels_colored) <- y_order

# Covert to long format for plotting
df_long <- matrix %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = x_order)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Model,
    names_to = "Covariate",
    values_to = "Included"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Covariate = factor(Covariate, levels = y_order),
    Included = as.numeric(Included)
  )
library(ggtext)

## Create separator positions
# Horizontal lines (between covariates)
h_lines <- seq(0.5, length(y_order) + 0.5, 1)
# Vertical lines (between models)
v_lines <- seq(0.5, length(x_order) + 0.5, 1)

p_incl <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Model, y = Covariate, fill = Included)) +
  geom_tile(color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#bfc7d6") +  
  scale_x_discrete(position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labels_colored) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.6,
                               color = "black", face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 9),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = h_lines, color = "black", linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = v_lines, color = "black", linewidth = 1)

ggsave(filename="25117_ML_CS_model_inclusion_variables_v2.pdf", plot = p_incl, width = 3, height = 8)
```

```{r}
feature_importance_df <- read.csv("~/Documents/GitHub/PreclinicalAD_GutMicrobiome-Inflammation/R/Data/ML/long_feature_importances.csv") %>%
  select(-any_of("X")) %>%
  rename(
    Education = Years_Education,
    `APOE4 Carriage` = apoe4_carriage,
    Calprotectin = log2_Calp,
    `Guild Abundance` = guild_abundance,
    `Bacteroides cellulosilyticus` = k__Bacteria.p__Bacteroidetes.c__Bacteroidia.o__Bacteroidales.f__Bacteroidaceae.g__Bacteroides.s__Bacteroides_cellulosilyticus_abundance,
    `Roseburia sp CAG 471` = k__Bacteria.p__Firmicutes.c__Clostridia.o__Clostridiales.f__Lachnospiraceae.g__Roseburia.s__Roseburia_sp_CAG_471_abundance,
    `Roseburia hominis` = k__Bacteria.p__Firmicutes.c__Clostridia.o__Clostridiales.f__Lachnospiraceae.g__Roseburia.s__Roseburia_hominis_abundance,
    `Hippocampus volume` = mr_vol_r_hippocampus,
    `Cortical Signature` = LOAD_CorticalSignature_Thickness,
    `WMH volume` = mr_vol_tot_wmhypointensities,
    `PET Amyloid` = combined.centiloid,
    `CSF t-tau` = LUMIPULSE_CSF_tTau,
    `CSF p-tau-181` = LUMIPULSE_CSF_pTau,
    `PET tau` = Tauopathy
  )

# Convert wide format to long format
feature_importance_long <- feature_importance_df %>%
  filter(!grepl("brain", feature_set, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%  # Remove brain feature sets
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(seed, feature_set),
    names_to = "feature_name",
    values_to = "importance"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(importance))

# Calculate mean and SD importance for each feature within each feature_set
feature_importance_summary <- feature_importance_long %>%
  group_by(feature_set, feature_name) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(importance),
    sd_importance = sd(importance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create the plot with tidytext
feature_importance_plot <- ggplot(feature_importance_summary, 
       aes(x = reorder_within(feature_name, mean_importance, feature_set), 
           y = mean_importance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_importance - sd_importance, 
                    ymax = mean_importance + sd_importance),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +  # Anchor at zero
  facet_wrap(~ feature_set, scales = "free",) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Mean Importance ± SD",
    title = "Feature Importance by Feature Set"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave(filename="~/Documents/GitHub/AD_longitudinal/outputs/260331/260331_ML_LN_model_gini_impurity_feature_importance.pdf", plot = feature_importance_plot, width = 18, height = 9)
```


```{r}
feature_importance_df <- read.csv("~/Documents/GitHub/PreclinicalAD_GutMicrobiome-Inflammation/R/Data/ML/CS_feature_importances.csv") %>%
  select(-any_of("X")) %>%
  rename(
    Education = Years_Education,
    `APOE4 Carriage` = apoe4_carriage,
    Calprotectin = log2_Calp,
    `Guild Abundance` = guild_abundance,
    `Bacteroides cellulosilyticus` = k__Bacteria.p__Bacteroidetes.c__Bacteroidia.o__Bacteroidales.f__Bacteroidaceae.g__Bacteroides.s__Bacteroides_cellulosilyticus_abundance,
    `Roseburia sp CAG 471` = k__Bacteria.p__Firmicutes.c__Clostridia.o__Clostridiales.f__Lachnospiraceae.g__Roseburia.s__Roseburia_sp_CAG_471_abundance,
    `Roseburia hominis` = k__Bacteria.p__Firmicutes.c__Clostridia.o__Clostridiales.f__Lachnospiraceae.g__Roseburia.s__Roseburia_hominis_abundance,
    `Hippocampus volume` = mr_vol_r_hippocampus,
    `Cortical Signature` = LOAD_CorticalSignature_Thickness,
    `WMH volume` = mr_vol_tot_wmhypointensities,
    `PET Amyloid` = combined.centiloid,
    `CSF t-tau` = LUMIPULSE_CSF_tTau,
    `CSF p-tau-181` = LUMIPULSE_CSF_pTau,
    `PET tau` = Tauopathy
  )

# Convert wide format to long format
feature_importance_long <- feature_importance_df %>%
  filter(!grepl("brain", feature_set, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%  # Remove brain feature sets
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(seed, feature_set),
    names_to = "feature_name",
    values_to = "importance"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(importance))

# Calculate mean and SD importance for each feature within each feature_set
feature_importance_summary <- feature_importance_long %>%
  group_by(feature_set, feature_name) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(importance),
    sd_importance = sd(importance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create the plot with tidytext
feature_importance_plot <- ggplot(feature_importance_summary, 
       aes(x = reorder_within(feature_name, mean_importance, feature_set), 
           y = mean_importance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_importance - sd_importance, 
                    ymax = mean_importance + sd_importance),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +  # Anchor at zero
  facet_wrap(~ feature_set, scales = "free",) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Mean Importance ± SD",
    title = "Feature Importance by Feature Set"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave(filename="~/Documents/GitHub/AD_longitudinal/outputs/260331/260331_ML_CS_model_gini_impurity_feature_importance.pdf", plot = feature_importance_plot, width = 18, height = 9)
```
